events.title: Devlog 4 : Three Years of Solo Development: Where the Game Is Now
events.summary: What is the game about?In very short terms, I draw inspiration from the games that influenced me the most: FTL, RimWorld, Dwarf Fortress, and Sid Meier’s Pirates!The core idea is this:You start by generating a galaxy with its own history — civilizations, states, factions, conflicts.
